description: Get the OpenAPI 3 schema for a model — its input/output fields (components.schemas). Use this to learn what inputs a model accepts before submitting. fal.ai API: GET /openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id={model_id}.

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

name: falai_get_model_schema
title: Get model schema
